newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank moves to support Agrobanka.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank moves to support Agrobanka.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Tuesday it was putting the largest private Czech bank, Agrobanka a.s., under temporary administration due to liquidity problems.

The central bank said in statement that Agrobanka's problems had arisen as a consequence of the failure of Kreditni Banka Plzen a.s. and the investigation of people in the Kreditni case who are also connected to Agrobanka.

"The investigation of the fall of Kreditni Banka Plzen and its politicization, and charges against people connected to Agrobanka negatively influences the liquidity position of this bank (Agrobanka)," the CNB said in its statement.

In order to support Agrobanka the CNB said it would guarantee all deposits at the bank and that it would ensure, in cooperation with other commercial banks, sufficient "financial sources" for Agrobanka, should it need them.
The CNB said the above measures constituted the "temporary administration" of Agrobanka by the central bank.
"The method and aim of these measures are different in kind from the forced administrations (of other banks) conducted in the past," the CNB statement said.
"The business of Agrobanka, in all trading outlets, continues as normal. Agrobanka has sufficient capital and reserves," the statement added.
On Friday CNB Governor Josef Tosovsky said media reaction to the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. last month temporarily destabilised the banking sector, but that it was basically sound.
